messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 11(9)

Article 11 Obligations of manufacturers of partly completed machinery. 9. Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that partly completed machinery into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate. Furthermore, where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards the relevant essential health and safety requirements, manufacturers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the partly completed machinery available on the market to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken.

response.text:
Manufacturers | mustTakeCorrectiveActions | take corrective actions necessary to bring the partly completed machinery into conformity, withdraw it, or recall it, as appropriate | manufacturers consider or have reason to believe the partly completed machinery placed on the market is not in conformity | "shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary to bring that partly completed machinery into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it, as appropriate"
Manufacturers | mustInformAuthorities | immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States where the machinery was made available on the market | partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements | "manufacturers shall immediately inform the competent national authorities of the Member States in which they made the partly completed machinery available on the market to that effect"
Notification to authorities | includesDetails | details of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken | partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements | "giving details, in particular, of the non-conformity and of any corrective actions taken"
